mission: Fix the depfix pipeline so that both VERSION DRIFT and API CALL-SITE DRIFT are detected and produce working fix PRs. Currently: scan finds call sites but plan produces 0 PRs. The pipeline must go init → scan → plan → apply and open a real PR on GitHub with correct fixes.

tasks.title: Research: trace why plan produces 0 PRs after scan finds call sites
tasks.acceptance: Researcher writes research/plan-zero-pr-root-cause.md documenting: (1) exact data flow from scan output → BreakingChange records → assess_scan_change() → plan filtering, (2) why no BreakingChange records exist for multi-major-version jumps, (3) what T-15's repo_exports.py was supposed to fix and whether its code is actually in dependency_check/src/. Include file paths, line numbers, and command outputs.
tasks.next_action: Researcher: trace scan→BreakingChange→assess_scan_change→plan data flow in dependency_check; write research/plan-zero-pr-root-cause.md with file:line evidence and command outputs; set status=review when done
tasks.notes: Known context: ts_exports_diff only compares consecutive versions. _previous_major_release() in ts_exports.py:171 only goes back ONE major. assess_scan_change() in matching.py:43-106 requires pre-existing BreakingChange record. T-15 code (repo_exports.py) may still be in depfix-agents, not dependency_check. | Assigned to researcher 2026-10-11T21:48:14Z.

tasks.title: Fix ts_exports_diff to detect API removals across multiple major versions
tasks.acceptance: When a repo has SDK version X installed and latest is version Y (where Y - X > 1 major), ts_exports_diff compares X's exports against Y's exports and creates BreakingChange records for all removed symbols. Uses existing _exports_for(version) which can fetch ANY version's exports. make test passes, new unit tests cover the multi-major case.
tasks.next_action: Assign to implementer after T-17 research is done
tasks.notes: Key file: dependency_check/src/depfix/sources/ts_exports.py. _exports_for(version) at line ~185 can fetch exports for any npm version via tarball download — this is the building block.

tasks.title: Fix plan to generate fix PRs when BreakingChange records + call sites exist
tasks.acceptance: When scan finds call sites AND BreakingChange records exist (from T-18), plan produces a non-empty fix plan. apply opens a PR on GitHub with the correct code changes. Tested on bedilk/depfix-test-sentry-v6-app (sentry.startTransaction must get a fix PR). make test passes.
tasks.notes: Key files: matching.py (assess_scan_change), learned.py (_detected_entry, _is_behind, _reason). The plan may also need changes if the filtering logic drops valid matches.

tasks.title: End-to-end test: full pipeline produces fix PRs on test repos
tasks.acceptance: Tester runs `depfix init && depfix scan && depfix plan && depfix apply` on: (1) bedilk/depfix-test-sentry-v6-app — version drift + API drift, (2) bedilk/depfix-test-openai-v3-chat — version drift, (3) bedilk/seed-openai-v3-to-v4. For each: document whether a PR was opened on GitHub, what the PR contains, whether the fix is correct. Write results to research/e2e-fix-pr-results.md.
tasks.notes: Use --dry-run first, then real apply with PR. The GitHub App is installed on these repos (credentials in dependency_check/.env).

tasks.title: Real-repo validation: verify fix PRs on firecrawl and Rocket.Chat
tasks.acceptance: Tester runs the full pipeline on bedilk/firecrawl (anthropic + openai) and bedilk/Rocket.Chat (mongodb). Documents whether PRs are opened, fix quality, false positive rate. Write to research/real-repo-fix-validation.md.
tasks.next_action: Assign to tester after T-20 passes
tasks.notes: These are larger repos. firecrawl had 21 openai + 17 anthropic call sites. Rocket.Chat had 39 mongodb call sites.

tasks.acceptance: All code changes from T-18 and T-19 are on a feature branch in dependency_check, pushed to GitHub, with a PR opened via `gh pr create`. PR description summarizes what changed and why. CI passes.
